display.title: After Yud-Beis Tammuz: The Rebbe's Mesiras Nefesh and a Song of Geulah
display.summary_short: The day after Yud-Beis Tammuz, Uncle Yossi recalls the Frierdiker Rebbe's readiness to give his life for children's Torah learning and introduces a song of Geulah.
display.summary_long: A Yud-Beis Tammuz talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given the day after the holiday. Uncle Yossi recalls how the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneerson, was freed from prison on Yud-Beis Tammuz when his life was in danger, and how we thank Hashem for those miracles and pray for miracles in our time that will end the golus. The Rebbe set an example for all generations: his love of Torah was so great that he was ready to give his life so Torah could be learned freely everywhere, especially by young children, with true yiras Shamayim. In honor of the day, Uncle Yossi introduces a song of Geulah, 'Ki v'simchah seitzei'u', which we will sing when Moshiach comes, and explains the prophet Daniel's words that heavenly clouds will carry the Jewish people swiftly to Eretz Yisroel. The march itself is not included.
display.lesson: The Frierdiker Rebbe was ready to give his life so that children would learn Torah; we look forward with joy to the final Geulah.
